post.description: Cancel a PNR in the service.  Can only be used if service status is `new`

VOID a PNR in the service. Depends on the airline policy.
By default tickets can be VOIDed on the same day of issuance. 
Some airlines may have a limitations on VOID policy. 
I.e. 1 hour after issuance, 3 hours after issuance, etc.
Some airlines prohibit VOID if the flight is on the current or the next day

AirPassenger.description: Passenger type for reservation create request

documentType.description:
Passenger's document type. Possible values:
  * __1__ - Local identity card
  * __2__ - International passport
  * __3__ - Birth certificate
  * __4__ - Internal passport
  * __5__ - Diplomatic passport
  * __6__ - Resident card

class.description: Class of the flight: `Y` - Economy, `B` - Business, `F` - First Class

currency.description: Currency code of the current option

price.description: Total option price for all passengers

baseFare.description: Base price of the option. All brands are prices should be added to this value.

families.description: Brands for the current option. Each trip has its own array of brands.

id.description: Brand ID returned by the provider.

name.description: Brand name returned by the provider.

baggageInfos.description: Baggage information in this fare family.

price.description: Price of the combination, in addition to base fare.

familyIDs.description: Fare families IDs in this combination.

description.description: Service description returned by the provider.

paymentType.description:
Payment type for this service. Possible values:
  * __included__ - Free service
  * __chargeable__ - Paid service
  * __na__ - Not available in this package

passengerQty.description: Number of passengers of the given type.

total.description: Total amount for the passenger, including taxes and service fee.

arrival.description: Arrival date and time. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

serviceClass.description: Service class code. `Y` - Economy, `B` - Business, `F` - First Class

departure.description: Departure date and time. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

layover.description: Layover time before the next flight, in minutes

Order.description: Order object used for storing and controlling services

status.description:
Order status. Possible statuses:
- `draft` - order is created but not issued yet
- `issued` - order is issued
- `cancelled` - order is cancelled by the client
- `refunded` - order is refunded by the client
- `void` - order is voided by the client
- `expired` - order was not issued before the time-limit
- `pending-issue` - order being issued by the system
- `partially-refunded` - order is partially refunded

updatedAt.description: Order last updated date.  Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

issuedAt.description: Order issue date date.  Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

status.description:
Service Status. . Possible statuses:
- `new` - service is created but not issued yet
- `issued` - service is issued
- `cancelled` - service is cancelled by the client
- `refunded` - service is refunded by the client
- `void` - service is voided by the client
- `expired` - service was not issued before the time-limit
- `partially-refunded` - service is partially refunded

updatedAt.description: Order last updated date.  Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

message.description: Response message. Contains error message if error occurred
